_comment: Team roles. To add a role: add an entry here and create agents/<name>.md (its system prompt). The manager reads this catalog and fans a role out into multiple parallel workers when 'fan_out' applies. 'model' is 'worker' (cheap, default), 'lead' (strong), or a literal model id. 'max_parallel' caps concurrent workers of this role.

roles.name: backend
roles.summary: Server-side code: APIs, data, business logic.
roles.fan_out: Split into several backend tasks when the work has independent modules/endpoints that live in different files and share no state (e.g. an auth service and a reporting service). Keep as one task if the pieces touch the same files or must be built in order.

roles.name: frontend
roles.summary: Client-side UI built against backend contracts.
roles.fan_out: Split when there are separate, independent pages/components in different files. Keep as one task if they share layout, state, or a single entry file.

roles.name: tester
roles.summary: Runs the software and verifies acceptance criteria.
roles.fan_out: Split into multiple tester tasks when there are several independent areas to verify that need no shared ordering — e.g. one tester per service, or splitting a long suite of independent checks in half — so they run in parallel and finish sooner. Keep as one task if verification is quick or the steps must run in sequence (login must pass before testing the dashboard).
